_comment: Facts that must be stored for sample_rfp.pdf given sample_rfp_llm_responses.json: the 7 + 5 verified items, none of the 3 bad ones, with nulls dropped from structured fields.

requirements.requirement_text: The contract period shall be 36 months from the date of Go-Live, including 12 months of warranty support.
The solution shall be developed using an open-source technology stack with PostgreSQL as the database.
The portal shall integrate with the State Payment Gateway and DigiLocker through secure REST APIs.
The bidder shall provide 24x7 helpdesk support with a maximum resolution time of 4 hours for critical incidents.
The application must undergo a security audit by a CERT-In empanelled auditor before Go-Live.
Project Manager - 1 resource with minimum 10 years of experience in IT project delivery.
Java Developer - 4 resources with minimum 5 years of experience each.

eligibility.criterion_text: The bidder must have an average annual turnover of at least Rs. 10 Crore during the last three financial years.
The bidder must have successfully completed at least 3 similar projects, each of value not less than Rs. 2 Crore, for Government or PSU clients.
The bidder must hold a valid ISO 27001 certification.
Earnest Money Deposit of Rs. 5,00,000 shall be submitted along with the bid.
Micro and Small Enterprises registered with NSIC or Udyam are exempted from payment of EMD as per the Public Procurement Policy for MSEs Order, 2012.
